name.en: Atlas 800T A3 server cluster (8 NPUs per server, RoCE between servers)

record.before: Atlas 800T A3 server cluster (8 NPUs per server, RoCE between servers)
Atlas 800T A3 服务器集群（8 NPU / 台，跨机 RoCE）
paper: one RDMA port per die, 400 Gb/s per NPU; radix 64 and non-blocking assumed; the same as in the other “950 and 910C” report
论文：每 die 1 个 RDMA 口、每 NPU 400 Gb/s；端口数 64 与无收敛为假设；与另一份《950 与 910C》报告相同
2 × 200G per NPU, 64-port switches, non-blocking folded Clos (HAC-D template default, main case)
每 NPU 2 × 200G、64 口交换机、无收敛折叠 Clos（HAC-D 模板默认，主算例）
a current 51.2T switch chip used with 200G ports (assumed)
现行 51.2T 交换芯片按 200G 口使用（假设）
third-party 800I A3 listing: 8 × 400GE per server; FiberMall relaying SemiAnalysis: 1,536 scale-out modules per CM384 = 384 NIC + 768 leaf + 384 spine
第三方 800I A3 规格：每台 8 × 400GE；FiberMall 转述 SemiAnalysis：每 CM384 scale-out 1,536 只模块 = 384 网卡 + 768 叶 + 384 脊
main case with 2:1 at the leaves
主算例 + 叶层 2:1 收敛

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_cab row 5; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: Fan module 1200 FIT = 1200 FIT/device × 8 per cabinet × impact 0.3 (over-temperature trips per fan fault (Q3 thermal log); derived) = 2880 FIT per cabinet-hour, business-impact, class COOL-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_npu row 3; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: Ascend 910C module 900 FIT = 900 FIT/device × 1 per npu × impact 0.5 (runtime exceptions attributed to the module (Q3 incident review); derived) = 450 FIT per npu-hour, business-impact, class CORE-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_npu row 3; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: Ascend 910C module 900 FIT = 900 FIT/device × 1 per npu × impact 0.04 (silent-result incidents per module return (Q3 incident review); assumed) = 36 FIT per npu-hour, business-impact, class CORE-sdc; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: CPU vendor datasheet rev C section 4.2; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: Kunpeng 920 CPU 2500000 h MTBF → 10⁹ / MTBF = 400 FIT/device × 1 per cpu × impact 0.8 (host interruptions per CPU fault (Q3 incident review); derived) = 320 FIT per cpu-hour, business-impact, class CPU-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_mem row 2; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: DDR5 DIMM 64 GB 35 FIT = 35 FIT/device × 32 per node × impact 0.5 (UCE share after ECC (Q3 memory log); derived) = 560 FIT per node-hour, business-impact, class DDR-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: FIDES prediction 2026Q2 sheet UB; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: UB L1 switch chip 60 FIT = 60 FIT/device × 1 per ub-switch × impact 1 (one L1 chip loss stalls the server fabric; assumed) = 60 FIT per ub-switch-hour, business-impact, class FABRIC-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: switch vendor datasheet section 7; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: RoCE switch 128-port 300000 h MTBF → 10⁹ / MTBF = 3333.33 FIT/device × 1 per roce-switch × impact 0.02 (ECMP: share of switch faults that stall a job (Q3 network log); assumed) = 66.6667 FIT per roce-switch-hour, business-impact, class FABRIC-hard@roce; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_npu row 7; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: HBM3 stack 80 FIT = 80 FIT/device × 8 per npu × impact 0.6 (UCE share after ECC (Q3 memory log); derived) = 384 FIT per npu-hour, business-impact, class MEMT-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: FIDES prediction 2026Q2 sheet MGMT; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: iBMC management module 400 FIT = 400 FIT/device × 1 per node × impact 1 (BMC loss blocks the node (ops rule); assumed) = 400 FIT per node-hour, business-impact, class MGMT-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_npu row 3; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: Ascend 910C module 900 FIT = 900 FIT/device × 1 per npu × impact 0.2 (share of module returns that interrupted a job (Q3 incident review); derived) = 180 FIT per npu-hour, business-impact, class MODULE-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_net row 1; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: RoCE NIC 200G 60 FIT = 60 FIT/device × 1 per npu × impact 1 (every NIC loss interrupts the job (no NIC redundancy); measured) = 60 FIT per npu-hour, business-impact, class NIC-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: ACME field returns 2026Q3 tbl_net row 4; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: QSFP-DD 400G transceiver 300 FIT = 300 FIT/device × 2 per roce-link × impact 0.2 (link-loss share after retraining (Q3 network log); derived) = 120 FIT per roce-link-hour, business-impact, class OPT-hard@roce; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: PSU vendor datasheet p. 12; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: PSU 3 kW 600000 h MTBF → 10⁹ / MTBF = 1666.67 FIT/device × 6 per cabinet × impact 0.6 (N+1 shelf: share of PSU faults that drop the cabinet (Q3 power log); derived) = 6000 FIT per cabinet-hour, business-impact, class POWER-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27

rates.source: acme-fit-2026q3.csv / Sheet1: SSD vendor reliability report 2026H1 p. 3; 口径 mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing
rates.derivation: NVMe SSD 3.84 TB 0.012 AFR → −ln(1 − AFR) / 8760 h × 10⁹ = 1378.15 FIT/device × 2 per node × impact 0.5 (RAID-1 pair: a single-disk loss is tolerated half the time (ops rule); assumed) = 1378.15 FIT per node-hour, business-impact, class SSD-hard; mapping acme-fit-2026q3-koujing 2026-10-27
